component.name: Xinput Plus
component.summary: Adjust pointer speed per device (Xorg) via xinput

description.p: Xinput-plus provides a simple PyQt6 GUI to manage per-device pointer acceleration on Xorg, with per-ID/name profiles, whitelisting, natural scrolling, tap-to-click, and a CTM fallback when "libinput Accel Speed" is not available.

Added UI translations for twelve more languages (German, Russian, Japanese, Chinese Simplified and Traditional, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Arabic, Turkish and Korean), XDG_CONFIG_HOME support, and a fixed application icon that now renders in GTK menus as well.
Renamed the extended-mode checkbox to "Extra speed (for slow devices)", fixed the translation-file lookup logic, refreshed the Spanish translation and completed the man page.
Added the docs folder with Debian packaging guides.
Natural scrolling and tap-to-click per device, translatable About dialog, two-row action layout, and AppStream metadata with an OARS rating.
End-to-end internationalization: all UI strings translatable, a robust runtime translator loader and the --lang option.
